messages:
sam: Quick sync — planning a gradual rollout for structured output / function-calling support. Proposal: server-side compat flag + percent canary + allowlist. Need SDK owners to confirm fallback behavior. Details below.

leah: +1 on gradual. Suggest starting at 2% for production accounts, 10% for staging. Also enable per-account allowlist for enterprise customers. :white_check_mark: 

omar: Agree. Flag keys I propose:
```
structured_output.function_calling_rollout: {
  state: "canary" | "on" | "off",
  percent: 2,
  allowlist: ["acct-..."],
  compat_mode_default: true
}
```
Server will check client version header and override if older than 3.4.0 (keep compat_mode=true).

jia: SDK note — we'll default new SDKs (>=3.4.0) to strict mode (function calls parsed into structured objects). Older SDKs should get compat_mode: true so they receive a JSON blob and don't error. We'll add runtime opt-in: ClientOptions.structuredOutputStrict = false/true.

hannah: Monitoring / guardrails: please add these metrics to the canary dashboard:
- function_call_rate
- function_parse_errors
- structured_parse_latency_ms
- token_delta_per_request
Set alerts for parse_errors > 0.5% or 5 errors in 5m.

omar: Also instrument logs with "function_call_v2" tag and expose sample payloads to S3 (redacted) for first 1000 canary calls.

deploy-bot: canary toggle created: structured_output_v2.canary = 2% (state=canary). Rollout ID = r-2026-03-17-001

sam: Thanks — @omar @jia please review the flag format and SDK default. @leah can you coordinate the ops runbook for rollback? I'll draft a short customer comms note for enterprise allowlist. Target rollout window: start next Tue 09:00 PT, watch 2h then bump to 10% if green.

leah: I'll own rollback runbook. Will add step: flag -> set state=off and purge temp cache keys.

jia: I'll open a tiny PR in SDK repo to add ClientOptions.structuredOutputStrict and add a changelog entry. cc @sam

sam: Great. If nobody objects by EOD, I'll schedule the canary. :rocket:
